rows.current_in_db: Four days of US/UK airstrikes on Iraqi military and WMD targets during the UNSCOM inspections crisis; Iraqi exports were sanction-limited then, so expected supply disruption was moderate. DRAFT coding.
rows.proposed: On December 16, 1998, Clinton ordered strikes whose 'mission is to attack Iraq's nuclear, chemical, and biological programs and its military capacity to threaten its neighbors,' following UNSCOM Chairman Butler's report that Iraq was not cooperating with inspections ; the same night the UN Security Council divided sharply, with the U.S. and U.K. defending the action and Russia and China objecting to force without Council authorization .
